data.title: Bitcoin Bridge Boltz Halts Swaps Indefinitely, Citing AI-Assisted Attacks | The Defiant
data.description: Boltz, the non-custodial bridge that routes swaps between bitcoin's mainchain, the Lightning Network and Liquid, disabled its service indefinitely on Monday, saying months of automated, AI-assisted attacks on its infrastructure have outpaced its ability to ship fixes.
data.author: The Defiant Team
